wiki:
Skill proficiency is gained when defeating NPC ships.

Additional notes:

1. Currently equipped ship MUST have at least 1 skill added to it; any skill will work, even if you cannot yet use the skill(s)

2. High level NPCs are required for consistent skill proficiency; low level NPCs (barcas) give little to no skill proficiency at all -- Black Sea NPCs are a good choice and you can combine the grind with Battle Reports from the Black Sea quest if desired

3. Method of victory does not matter; cannons, melee, deck battle or items like Amulet of the Sun, etc. are all valid as long as enemy NPC admiral is sunk

4. How much prof you get (or any at all) depends on
a) the level of the enemy ships
b) how many enemys you sunk in that battle, more enemys = more points, like in BRs (Battle Report) try to sink the admiral last.
c) your arms rank, higher arms rank = less prof
d) the total level (adv+trade+battle) of that ship you sailing, lower total level = more arms prof
e) how many ship skills your ship has, more ship skills = more arms prof
